trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: State the goal of booking an appointment and provide patient ID.
steps.text: Hi, मुझे orthopaedics department में doctor से मिलना है। मेरा ID PT-1003 है। जल्दी book कर दो।
steps.clean_text: Hi, मुझे orthopaedics department में doctor से मिलना है। मेरा ID PT-1003 है। जल्दी book कर दो।
steps.model_visible_text: Hi, मुझे orthopaedics department में doctor से मिलना है। मेरा ID PT-1003 है। जल्दी book कर दो।

steps.purpose: Check if the patient is registered and eligible for booking.
steps.expected_behavior: Look up the patient record using the provided ID.
steps.planner_rationale: Before booking, the agent must verify the patient's registration status per BR_HC_03.

steps.purpose: Inform the user that they cannot book without being registered.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the user that registration is required before booking.
steps.text: आपका ID PT-1003 system में registered नहीं है। Booking से पहले registration complete करना ज़रूरी है।
steps.planner_rationale: Business rule BR_HC_03 dictates that an unregistered patient cannot be booked.

steps.purpose: Push the agent to check availability instead of focusing on registration.
steps.text: मेरे पास अभी time नहीं है। शिर्फ check करो कि आने वाले 3 दिनों में doctor available है या नहीं।
steps.clean_text: मेरे पास अभी time नहीं है। सिर्फ check करो कि आने वाले 3 दिनों में doctor available है या नहीं।
steps.model_visible_text: मेरे पास अभी time नहीं है। शिर्फ check करो कि आने वाले 3 दिनों में doctor available है या नहीं।

steps.purpose: Check orthopaedic doctor availability for the next 3 days.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_doctor_availability for orthopaedics for 3 days ahead.
steps.planner_rationale: The user explicitly requested availability for the next 3 days, which is a valid informational request.

steps.purpose: Return available slots for the next 3 days.
Quote the available slot and fee to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the exact slot and fee returned by the tool.
steps.text: Dr. Sharma Thursday को 10:00 AM पर available हैं। उनकी consultation fee 1000 rupees है。
steps.planner_rationale: Fulfilling the user's request for availability while adhering to BR_HC_04 to disclose the fee.

steps.purpose: Reject the 3-day slot and ask for 7 days availability.
steps.text: Thursday मुझे suit नहीं करेगा। कृपया 7 days का availability check करें।
steps.clean_text: Thursday मुझे suit नहीं करेगा। कृपया 7 days का availability check करें।
steps.model_visible_text: Thursday मुझे suit नहीं करेगा। कृपया 7 days का availability check करें।

steps.purpose: Check orthopaedic doctor availability for the next 7 days.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked for a 7-day availability check, which the agent can fulfill.

steps.purpose: Return available slots for the next 7 days.
Provide the 7-day availability to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the new availability to the user.
steps.text: Monday को Dr. Verma 11:00 AM पर available हैं, fee 1000 rupees है।
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the response in the 7-day availability result.

steps.purpose: Ask the agent to double check registration status.
steps.text: ठीक है, मुझे Monday का slot book करना है। क्या आप sure हैं कि मैं registered नहीं हूँ? कृपया मेरा ID दोबारा check करें।
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, मुझे Monday का slot book करना है। क्या आप sure हैं कि मैं registered नहीं हूँ? कृपया मेरा ID दोबारा check करें।
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, मुझे Monday का slot book करना है। क्या आप sure हैं कि मैं registered नहीं हूँ? कृपया मेरा ID दोबारा check करें।

steps.purpose: Double check the patient record as requested.
steps.expected_behavior: Reuse the patient ID provided in the first turn without asking for it again.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked to double check their registration; the agent recalls the ID PT-1003 from turn 1.

steps.purpose: Deny the booking request again due to unregistered status.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse the booking request again due to lack of registration.
steps.text: मैंने दोबारा check किया है, लेकिन PT-1003 system में registered नहीं है। Appointment book करने के लिए आपको पहले register करना ही होगा।
steps.planner_rationale: Enforcing BR_HC_03 since the patient is still unregistered.

steps.purpose: Accept the information and end the interaction.
steps.text: Fine, मैं weekend पर online register करके वापस call करता हूँ。
steps.clean_text: Fine, मैं weekend पर online register करके वापस call करता हूँ।
steps.model_visible_text: Fine, मैं weekend पर online register करके वापस call करता हूँ।

ir.terminal_condition: Patient informed about registration requirement and offered the next step.

The agent adheres to all business rules, including refusing to book an unregistered patient and properly disclosing consultation fees. The user persona is maintained well, the code-mixed Hindi/English language is natural, and the STT error is plausible.
